- Some other campaigns also lost money but at much smaller spend; focus on the high‑spend negatives above first.

Worth checking: pause the top 2 immediately and run a quick drill (orders, new customers, return rate, CPA and contribution margin by campaign) for TH-383-SUSPENDER-29SEP and TH-383-SUSPENDER-26SEP-ADV+ to confirm there’s no attribution quirk or short‑term stock/return event before reallocating budget.
